missions.title: Inventory existing VR source and headset target
acceptance: Search all authorized existing repositories for VR source, assets, app IDs, and prior build workflows
Identify exact headset model/OS only from authorized device inventory or owner confirmation
Record reuse decision; do not duplicate existing project

missions.title: Define persistent world service and typed control API
acceptance: Durable snapshots, event log, idempotent jobs

missions.title: Build owner-only website VR Builder
acceptance: No privileged browser secrets or public access

missions.title: Create native Android/OpenXR client spike
acceptance: Godot 4/OpenXR compatibility tested on actual target

missions.title: Implement asset/content update channel
acceptance: Immutable asset bundles and hash verification
Offline cache and safe reconnect reconciliation

missions.title: Implement CI build, artifact, and release gates
Implement authorized device relay and auto-install
acceptance: Queued update installs when device is reachable
missions.owner_gate: Owner must complete developer-mode/device-debug authorization and enroll a trusted relay; do not bypass.

missions.title: Connect website publish workflow to device rollout
acceptance: Owner can edit and preview from existing site

missions.title: Prove offline operation and restart recovery
Create frontier research and education pipeline
acceptance: Experiments have hypotheses, baselines, metrics, and reproducible artifacts
Publish tutorials and research notes only with evidence and clear limitations

missions.title: Publish browser-based WebXR world preview
acceptance: GhostCorp WebXR scene is committed at /vr/
Desktop fallback renders a navigable 3D hub
Immersive WebXR entry is offered when supported
Controller ray can select demo zones
Local editor can add and save custom scene nodes
Verify live deployment and test on the owner's actual headset browser
missions.notes: Prototype files committed; browser/device execution and deployment verification still pending. This does not satisfy the native APK or server-backed owner-builder missions.
